evidenceAssessment.notice: Incomplete birthdate evidence for eligible drivers. Sporting affiliations are represented, including neutral RAF without a national flag; unresolved birthdates can still change these age records.
evidenceAssessment.missingEvidence: Identity-bound complete birthdates for the excluded eligible drivers; credible biographies or documented corrections are acceptable evidence.

coverage.note: Ages use the separately accepted 784-driver birthdate evidence set. Drivers outside it remain unresolved, not age zero. Championship ages use the first F1DB clinching flag bound to the verified season champion. Nationality is the sporting nationality documented for that season or event; event-specific evidence takes precedence. No current-biography or adjacent-season extrapolation. Neutral (RAF) is a sporting affiliation without a national flag; RAF preserves the original designation.
knownExclusions: An eligible participant has unresolved or conflicting birthdate evidence; exact source dates are retained in stats-repair-demographics.v1.json. Development incorporation is authorised, but conflicts are not guessed.
